coordinated_activities.activity: Sleeping in bed with the air conditioner running to stay cool through the warm night
Waking up, using the toilet and taking a cool shower to freshen up
Making and eating breakfast with toast and a hot drink, drinking extra water before the hot day
Getting dressed in light work clothes, packing a water bottle and lunch, and checking the heatwave warning on the phone
Commuting to the health care facility, walking to the stop and travelling in the already hot morning air
Working as a health care professional on the ward, caring for patients, taking scheduled hydration breaks and watching for heat-related cases
Commuting home after the shift, stopping briefly to buy cold drinks and groceries for dinner
Cooking a light dinner on the induction cooker and eating it while cooling down
Relaxing on the sofa watching TV with the fan on and drinking cold water
Taking a second cool shower and changing into light sleepwear
Using the computer for personal tasks and light leisure, then tidying up a few small household chores
Winding down in bed, setting the air conditioner and phone alarm for the next shift
